hadith.loadingSearch: Ana loda rubutun littafin don bincike…
hadith.manyResults: Sakamako {n} na farko. Ƙara wata kalma don taƙaita bincike.
hadith.gradesNote: Lura: an kawo hukunce-hukuncen kamar yadda suka zo a majiyarsu. Wasu daga cikinsu a taƙaice suke, ba sa ambaton cikakken bayanin malamin, misali idan ya hukunta farkon hadisi da Sahihi amma ya hukunta wani ƙari a cikinsa da rauni. Don tabbatarwa, duba littattafan malamin da kansa.
hadith.source: Rubutun hadisai da hukunce-hukuncensu sun fito ne daga buɗaɗɗen aikin hadith-api. Sunayen littattafai da babobi sun fito ne daga hadith-json.
hadith.trSource: Fassarar ta fito ne daga aikin hadith-api.
hadith.radioNote: Watsa shirye ne na awa 24 daga mp3quran.net. Ana jin sa daga inda watsawar ta kai, kuma ba za a iya zaɓar wani hadisi na musamman ba.
tafsir.title: Tafsiri
tafsir.homeHint: Tafsirin kowace aya, ko karanta littafi gaba ɗaya
tafsir.missing: A majiyar, wannan littafi ba shi da tafsiri na musamman ga wannan aya. Duba ayar da ke gabanta ko wadda ke biye da ita.
tafsir.forVerses: Ana amfani da shi don tafsirin ayoyi
tafsir.useForVerses: Yi amfani da shi don tafsirin ayoyi
tafsir.useForVersesHint: Shi ne zai fara bayyana idan ka taɓa maɓallin tafsiri a kan aya
tafsir.intro: Taɓa kowace aya a cikin Alƙur'ani (ruwayar Hafs ko ta Shu'uba), sannan maɓallin tafsiri, don karanta bayaninta. Ko kuma karanta tafsirin sura gaba ɗaya daga ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan littattafai.
tafsir.arabicOnly: Waɗannan littattafan tafsiri da Larabci suke. Don ma'anoni a harshenka, zaɓi fassara a shafin Alƙur'ani.
tafsir.sourceQe: {book}: daga Kundin Alƙur'ani Mai Girma, QuranEnc.com, ana nuna shi ba tare da canji ba.
tafsir.sourceQul: {book}: daga Babban Ɗakin Karatun Alƙur'ani (QUL) na Tarteel da Quran.com, ta hanyar buɗaɗɗen aikin tafsir_api. Rubutun kamar yadda yake a majiya ne; an mayar da wasu 'yan wurare da aka sanya ƙarƙashin surar da ke maƙwabtaka zuwa surarsu.
tafsir.notesHint: Ƙananan rubutu a cikin baka bayanan editan littafin ne.
tafsir.sources: Al-Muyassar da al-Mukhtasar sun fito ne daga QuranEnc.com; sauran littattafan kuma daga Babban Ɗakin Karatun Alƙur'ani (Tarteel da Quran.com). Ana nuna rubutun yadda aka wallafa su.
tafsir.searchSurah: Bincika sura da suna ko lamba…
tajweed.title: Dokokin Tajweed
tajweed.hint: Bayanin dokokin da misalai daga Mushafi mai launuka
tajweed.inEnglish: Bayanan da ke wannan shafi da Turanci suke.
tajweed.audioNote: Ana karanta misalan da muryar Shehu Mahmud Khalil al-Husari bisa riwayar Hafs daga Asim, daga mp3quran.net.
asma.title: Sunayen Allah
asma.bookName: Sharhin Kyawawan Sunayen Allah a hasken Alƙur'ani da Sunna
asma.author: Wallafar Dr. Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, Allah ya jiƙansa, marubucin Hisnul Muslim
asma.intro: Sunaye casa'in da tara da Alƙur'ani da Sunna suka tabbatar. Marubucin ya tattara su tare da dalilansu, ya riƙe waɗanda Shaikh ʿAbd al-ʿAziz ibn Baz ya amince da su, kuma ya yi musu sharhi daga maganganun malamai kamar Ibn Taymiyyah, Ibn al-Qayyim da as-Saʿdi.
asma.arabicOnly: Littafin da sharhinsa da Larabci suke.
asma.method: Yadda marubucin ya tattara sunayen, da sunaye tabbatattu da bai yi musu sharhi ba
asma.together: Marubucin ya yi sharhin waɗannan sunaye tare.
asma.source: Rubutun “{book}” kamar yadda aka buga shi, daga kwafin turath.io da ya yi daidai da bugun (Safir Press, Riyadh).
faqih.title: Binciken fiƙihu
faqih.intro: Yi tambaya kan wata mas'ala ta fiƙihu: za a bincika littattafan ɗakin karatu (Mausu'ar Fiƙihu ta Kuwait, al-Mughni, al-Muhalla, matanonin mazhabobi da sauransu), a nuna abin da suka faɗa kalma da kalma, tare da juzu'i, shafi da hanyar zuwa wurin a cikin littafin.
faqih.disclaimer: Wannan bincike ne a cikin littattafai, ba fatawa ba: yana nuna abin da malamai suka rubuta, ba ya zaɓi tsakanin ra'ayoyinsu, kuma ba ya amsa al'amura na mutum. Don hukunci kan al'amarinka, tambayi malami.
faqih.arabicOnly: Rubuta tambayar da Larabci (haruffa 3 zuwa 300); amsar da rubutun suna cikin Larabci.
faqih.notFound: Ba a sami wannan mas'ala a cikin littattafan da ake da su ba. Gwada wasu kalmomi, kamar yadda fuƙaha'u suke faɗa, ko ka tambayi malami.
faqih.referScholar: Wannan ya shafi al'amarinka na kanka, kuma yana buƙatar hukuncin malami da zai ji cikakken bayaninsa; binciken ba ya amsa shi.
faqih.tooMany: Tambayoyi sun yi yawa a ɗan lokaci kaɗan; jira minti ɗaya ka sake gwadawa.
faqih.busy: Binciken ya kai iyakar tambayoyinsa na yau; da fatan za ka dawo gobe.
faqih.wordsNote: Waɗannan wurare ne a cikin littattafai da ke ɗauke da kalmomin tambayarka, mafi kusa a farko. Buɗe wurin don karanta maganar marubucin gaba ɗaya, a cikin mahallinta.
kutub.title: Aƙida da fiƙihu
kutub.intro: Littattafan farko na ilimi da manyan littattafansa: aƙidar Ahlus Sunna wal Jama'a, hadisi, fiƙihu a mazhabobi, da littattafan limamai kamar Ibn Qudamah, Ibn Hazm, Ibn Taymiyyah da Ibn al-Qayyim. Kowane littafi cikakke ne, kamar yadda aka buga shi.
kutub.aqidaIntro: Aƙidar Ahlus Sunna wal Jama'a kamar yadda limamanta suka rubuta ta, tare da dalilanta daga Alƙur'ani da Sunna.
kutub.fiqhIntro: Littafin da aka dogara da shi a kowace daga cikin mazhabobi huɗu, wato littafin farko da ɗalibin fiƙihu ke karantawa a mazhabarsa, sannan manyan littattafan fiƙihu kamar al-Mughni da al-Muhalla.
kutub.arabicOnly: Littattafan da Larabci suke, kamar yadda aka buga su.
kutub.source: Rubutun kamar yadda aka buga shi, daga kwafin turath.io da ya yi daidai da bugun.
kutub.offline: Duk abin da ka karanta a cikin waɗannan littattafai ana adana shi a na'urarka, kuma daga baya za ka iya karanta shi ba tare da intanet ba.
prayer.title: Lokutan salla
prayer.nightNote: Dare yana farawa daga Magariba har zuwa Asuba
prayer.setupIntro: Ana lissafa lokutan a na'urarka bisa wurinka, kuma suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba bayan an saita wurin.
prayer.useGps: Yi amfani da wurin da nake yanzu
prayer.gpsHint: Ana aika wurinka ne kawai a kusan-kusa: sau ɗaya zuwa OpenStreetMap don gano sunan birnin, da kuma zuwa sabar manhajar matuƙar faɗakarwa a kunne take.
prayer.searchOffline: Binciken birane yana buƙatar haɗin intanet
prayer.gpsFailed: An kasa gano wurinka. Ka ba da izinin samun wuri, ko ka bincika birninka.
prayer.manualHint: Ba ya buƙatar izinin wuri ko intanet: shigar da ma'aunin wurinka (coordinates), yankin lokaci da ƙasa, kuma za a lissafa lokutan daga cikinsu.
prayer.coordsHint: Za ka sami ma'aunin wuri a manhajar taswira ta hanyar dannawa ka riƙe kan wurinka, misali 30.044, 31.236 (ana iya liƙa su biyun tare).
prayer.manualInvalid: Duba ma'aunin wuri: latitude yana tsakanin −90 da 90, longitude kuma tsakanin −180 da 180.
prayer.zoneInvalid: Ba a san yankin lokacin ba; rubuta shi kamar Africa/Cairo.
prayer.manualPlace: Wurin da aka shigar da hannu
prayer.cityTime: Lokutan suna bisa agogon birnin da aka zaɓa
prayer.alertsHint: Tunatarwa kafin kowace salla, da kiran salla idan lokacinta ya yi
prayer.alertsEnabled: An kunna faɗakarwa da kiran salla
prayer.notifAsk: Burauza zai nemi izininka don nuna sanarwa
prayer.notifDenied: An toshe sanarwa ga wannan manhaja; ka ba da izini a saitunan burauza ko na na'ura. Duk da haka ana jin kiran salla matuƙar manhajar a buɗe take.
prayer.notifUnsupported: Wannan burauza ba ya iya nuna sanarwa. A iPhone, ƙara manhajar zuwa allon gida. Duk da haka ana jin kiran salla matuƙar manhajar a buɗe take.
prayer.notifOnlyOpen: Ba tare da izinin sanarwa ba, ana jin kiran salla ne kawai idan manhajar a buɗe take
prayer.pushOn: Faɗakarwa na riskar ka ko da manhajar a rufe take
prayer.welcomeLead: Ana lissafa lokutan salla a na'urarka don wurinka: tunatarwa na zuwa kafin kowace salla, kuma ana kunna kiran salla idan lokacinta ya yi.
prayer.pushUnsupported: An ba da izinin sanarwa, amma wannan burauza ba ya iya karɓar faɗakarwa idan manhajar a rufe take, don haka faɗakarwa na zuwa ne matuƙar manhajar a buɗe take.
prayer.pushFailed: Ba a iya yi wa wannan na'ura rajista don faɗakarwa lokacin da manhajar a rufe take ba; za a sake gwadawa ta atomatik. Kafin nan, faɗakarwa na zuwa ne matuƙar manhajar a buɗe take.
prayer.pushPrivacy: Don faɗakarwa ta riske ka idan manhajar a rufe take, ana adana wurinka (a kusan-kusa, kimanin kilomita ɗaya) da saitunan faɗakarwarka a sabar manhajar matuƙar faɗakarwa a kunne take, kuma ana goge su idan ka kashe ta.
prayer.sunriseNow: Rana ta fito: lokacin Asuba ya ƙare
prayer.fajrNote: A kiran sallar Asuba ana cewa «as-salatu khairun minan naum» (salla ta fi barci) sau biyu bayan «hayya 'alal falah».
prayer.v.malmo-fajr: Kiran sallar Asuba, Cibiyar Musulunci ta Malmö
prayer.v.sad: “Kiran salla na baƙin ciki”, Abdulmajid as-Surayhi
prayer.v.makkah-mulla-fajr: Kiran sallar Asuba, Ali Ahmad Mulla, Masallacin Harami
prayer.v.basit-fajr: Kiran sallar Asuba, Sheikh Abdulbasit Abdussamad
prayer.v.custom: Fayil ɗin kiran salla daga na'urarka
prayer.customPick: Zaɓi fayil ɗin sauti a na'urarka
prayer.customSaved: An adana fayil ɗin kiran salla a na'urarka
prayer.fileTooBig: Fayil ɗin ya fi MB {n} girma
prayer.voicesSource: Tushen rikodin (muryoyin malamai da na Masallatai Masu Alfarma biyu daga archive.org da islamweb.net suke; haƙƙinsu na masu su ne):
prayer.lengthCustom: Da fayil ɗinka: daƙiƙa {n} na farko
prayer.testHint: Yana kunna wani ɓangare na kiran salla kuma yana nuna sanarwa
prayer.testBody: Haka faɗakarwa za ta riske ka idan lokacin salla ya yi
prayer.how: Ana lissafa komai a na'urarka. Matuƙar manhajar a buɗe take, tunatarwa na zuwa kuma ana jin kiran salla; idan kuma a rufe take, sanarwa daga sabar manhajar na riskar ka a lokaci guda, idan burauza yana goyon bayan hakan.
prayer.howPhone: Sanarwa ba ta iya kunna kiran salla da aka naɗa: taɓa ta don buɗe manhajar ka kunna kiran salla daga can. A iPhone, ka fara ƙara manhajar zuwa allon gida. Wasu wayoyi suna jinkirta sanarwa don adana batir; idan sun yi jinkiri, cire manhajar ko burauza daga tsarin adana batir.
prayer.asrHint: Lokacin da inuwar abu ta yi daidai da tsawonsa, ko ninkinsa biyu a wurin Hanafiyya
prayer.highLatHint: Don ƙiyasta Asuba da Isha idan shafaƙi bai ɓace ba cikin dare a lokacin zafi
prayer.hl.seventh: Kashi ɗaya cikin bakwai na dare
prayer.adjustHint: Don su yi daidai da jadawalin masallacinka ko na ƙasarka
hijri.title: Kalandar Hijira
hijri.adjustHint: Idan an sanar da shigowar sabon wata a ƙasarku kwana ɗaya kafin ko bayan kalandar Umm al-Qura, daidaita kwanan wata a nan. Wannan daidaitawa tana shafar lokutan salla ma.
hijri.source: Kwanakin suna bin kalandar Umm al-Qura; ainihin farkon kowane wata ana tabbatar da shi ta ganin jinjirin wata a ƙasarku.
hijri.noDay30: Watan {month} bai da rana ta 30 a bana: wata yana da kwana 29 a kalandar Umm al-Qura.
hijri.sacredNote: Watanni masu alfarma huɗu su ne Zulka'ida, Zulhijja, Muharram da Rajab: laifi a cikinsu ya fi nauyi, aikin alheri kuma ya fi lada.
hijri.monThuNote: Annabi ﷺ yana himma wajen azumin Litinin da Alhamis, kwanakin da ake gabatar da ayyuka a cikinsu.
hijri.fridayNote: Ranar da ta fi alheri cikin ranakun da rana ta fito: Suratul Kahf, salati ga Annabi ﷺ da addu'a a sa'ar karɓar addu'a.
hijri.ev.newYearNote: Sabuwar shekarar Hijira ta fara. Muharram wata ne mai alfarma, kuma bayan Ramadan azumi mafi falala shi ne na Muharram (Muslim).
hijri.ev.tasuaNote: Ana so a yi azumin 9 ga Muharram tare da Ashura.
hijri.ev.ashuraNote: Azumin ranar Ashura yana kankare zunuban shekarar da ta wuce (Muslim).
hijri.ev.whiteNote: Ana so a yi azumin kwana uku a kowane wata, mafi alheri su ne 13, 14 da 15.
hijri.ev.ramadanNote: Watan azumi, sallar dare da Alƙur'ani, wanda ake buɗe ƙofofin Aljanna a cikinsa a kuma rufe ƙofofin Wuta.
hijri.ev.lastTen: Darare goma na ƙarshe na Ramadan
hijri.ev.lastTenNote: Ana neman Daren Lailatul Kadari a cikinsu, musamman darare mara adadi (Bukhari); Annabi ﷺ yana yin i'itikafi a cikinsu.
hijri.ev.fitrNote: Azumi a ranar Idi haramun ne. Ana fitar da Zakkatul Fitr kafin sallar Idi, ana kuma yin kabbara daga daren Idi har zuwa sallah.
hijri.ev.sixShawwalNote: Duk wanda ya yi azumin Ramadan sannan ya biyo shi da azumi shida na Shawwal, to kamar ya yi azumin shekara gaba ɗaya ne (Muslim).
hijri.ev.tenDhulHijjah: Kwanaki goma na farko na Zulhijja
hijri.ev.tenDhulHijjahNote: Babu wasu kwanaki da aikin alheri a cikinsu ya fi soyuwa ga Allah fiye da waɗannan kwanaki goma (Bukhari): azumi, zikiri da kabbara.
hijri.ev.tarwiyaNote: Ranar 8 ga Zulhijja, lokacin da alhazai ke fita zuwa Mina.
hijri.ev.arafahNote: Azumin ranar ga wanda ba ya aikin Hajji yana kankare zunuban shekaru biyu (Muslim); mafi alherin addu'a ita ce addu'ar ranar Arafa.
hijri.ev.adhaNote: Ranar yanka; azumi a cikinta haramun ne. Sallar Idi, layya da kabbara.
hijri.ev.tashriqNote: Ranakun ci, sha da ambaton Allah (Muslim); ba a azumi a cikinsu, kuma ana ci gaba da kabbara har zuwa ƙarshensu.
qibla.title: Alkiblar Ƙibla
qibla.setLocation: Saita wurinka domin gano alkiblar Ƙibla daga gare shi. Ana amfani da wannan wuri ɗaya don lokutan sallah.
qibla.turnTo: Juya wayarka har sai kibiya ta daidaita da Ka'aba
qibla.heading: Alkiblar waya
qibla.noCompass: Wannan na'ura ba ta da kamfas. Nuna alamar arewa ta zanen zuwa arewa ta gaskiya, kibiya za ta nuna maka Ƙibla, ko kuma ka yi amfani da rana kamar yadda yake a ƙasa.
qibla.compassDenied: Ba a ba da izinin shiga kamfas ba. Ba shafin izinin amfani da “Motsi da Alkibla” a saitunan burauza, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
qibla.calibrate: Idan kamfas ɗin ya yi kamar bai dace ba, motsa wayar a sama kamar siffar lamba 8 sau da yawa, nesa da ƙarfe da maganaɗisu.
qibla.sunHint: Ba tare da kamfas ba: a waɗannan lokuta yau rana tana daidai da alkiblar Ƙibla, ko kuma inuwar sanda tsaye tana nuna ta.
qibla.sunNone: Yau rana ba ta ratsa alkiblar Ƙibla ko kishiyarta a wurinka ba.
qibla.overKaabaNote: Sau biyu a shekara rana tana daidai saman Ka'aba, don haka a wannan lokaci alkiblarta ita ce Ƙibla daga duk inda ake ganinta: {dates}.
qibla.source: Ana lissafa alkibla a na'urarka ta layin da ya fi guntu a doron ƙasa zuwa Ka'aba. Kamfas ɗin waya kimantawa ne kuma yana iya kuskure da digiri kaɗan; idan zai yiwu, ka tabbatar da rana ko mihrabin masallaci na kusa.
prayer.source: Ana lissafa lokutan ta hanyar ilimin falaki a na'urarka. Idan sun bambanta da jadawalin masallacinka, ka daidaita su da minti.

install.iosStep2: Zaɓi “Ƙara zuwa allon gida” (“Add to Home Screen”) {icon} (idan ba ka gan shi ba, gungura jerin zuwa ƙasa).
install.inApp: Kana bincike ne a cikin wata manhaja, wadda ba ta iya shigar da manhajoji. Buɗe mahaɗin a burauzarka, sannan ka shigar da ita daga can.
install.inAppHint: Ko kuma, daga menu na ⋯ na wannan manhajar, zaɓi “Buɗe a burauza”.
install.macSafari: A Safari, zaɓi File › Add to Dock.
install.otherBrowser: Wannan burauza ba ya iya shigar da manhajoji. Buɗe shafin a Chrome ko Edge don shigar da ita.
install.installed: An shigar da manhajar a na'urarka.

about.title: Game da manhaja
about.hisnTitle: Hisnul Muslim: zikirai daga Alƙur'ani da Sunna
about.hisnAuthor: Wallafar Shaikh Sa'id bin Ali bin Wahf Al-Qahtani, Allah ya jiƙansa.
about.hisnSource: An ɗauko rubutun daga shafin littafin na hukuma {link}: {chapters} da {adhkar}.
about.fadlText: Falala, mai ruwaya da tushen kowane zikirin safiya da yamma an ɗauko su daga bayanan ƙasan shafi na bugaggen Hisnul Muslim da kuma sharhinsa na Majdi ibn Abdul-Wahhab al-Ahmad wanda marubucin littafin ya duba, kamar yadda suke a {link} ba tare da canji ba.
about.offline: Manhajar tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba bayan buɗewa ta farko, kuma ba ta tattara wani bayani.
about.mushafText: Rubutun Alƙur'ani da haruffansa cikin ruwayoyi takwas sun fito ne daga {source}, kuma ana nuna su daidai yadda aka wallafa su.
about.mushafOffline: Ana adana kowace ruwaya a na'urar bayan buɗe ta karon farko, don a iya karanta ta ba tare da intanet ba.
about.trText: Fassarorin ma'anonin Alƙur'ani sun fito ne daga Kundin Alƙur'ani Mai Girma {link}, kuma ana nuna su ba tare da canji ba tare da sunan mai fassara da sigar. Fassarar Turanci ta zikirai ta fito ne daga shafin Hisnul Muslim na hukuma.
about.machineNote: An fassara manhajar da kanun babobi zuwa wannan harshe da taimakon kwamfuta, kuma suna buƙatar a duba su. Ba a taɓa fassara rubutun zikirai da na Alƙur'ani da na'ura ba.
about.audioText: Karatuttuka da tashoshin masu karatu sun fito ne daga {link}, tashoshin kai-tsaye kuma daga tushensu na hukuma. Ana buƙatar haɗin intanet.
about.tafsirText: Al-Muyassar da al-Mukhtasar sun fito ne daga {qe}; tafsirin as-Saʿdi, al-Baghawi, Ibn Kathir, al-Qurtubi da at-Tabari kuma daga buɗaɗɗen ɗakin karatu na {qul}. Ana nuna su yadda aka wallafa su.
about.tajweedText: Taƙaitaccen bayanin dokokin ruwayar Hafs daga Asim ta hanyar Shatibiyya, tare da misalai da launuka daga shafukan Mushafin Tajweed mai launuka, da baitocin «Tuhfat al-Atfal» da «al-Muqaddima al-Jazariyya» da Dr. Abdulmuhsin al-Qasim ya tantance, daga {link}.
about.asmaText: Cikakken littafin “Sharhin Kyawawan Sunayen Allah a hasken Alƙur'ani da Sunna” na Al-Qahtani, kamar yadda aka buga shi, daga kwafin {link}.
about.kutubText: Littattafan aƙida, hadisi, fiƙihu da usulinsa, tarihin Annabi da tafarkin tsarkake rai, cikakku kamar yadda aka buga su, daga kwafin {link} da suka yi daidai da bugun; kowane littafi yana ambaton mai tahƙiƙinsa da mawallafinsa.
about.hijriText: Tana bin kalandar Umm al-Qura kamar yadda mai bincike (browser) ke lissafa ta, ana iya daidaita ta da kwana ɗaya ko biyu bisa ganin jinjirin wata a ƙasarku; lokutan ibada da ake nunawa su ne waɗanda Sunna ta tabbatar.
about.qiblaText: Ana lissafa ta a na'urarka daga wurin lokutan sallah, ta layin da ya fi guntu zuwa Ka'aba; ana karanta kamfas ɗin waya a na'urar kuma karatunsa ba ya fita daga cikinta. Tare da kamfas akwai lokutan da rana take nuna Ƙibla.
about.prayerText: Ana lissafa su a na'urar bisa hanyoyin hukumomin kowace ƙasa. Binciken birane daga {geo}; sunayen wurare daga {osm}; faɗakarwa lokacin da manhajar a rufe take na zuwa ne daga sabar manhajar a {cf}.
about.adhanText: Rikodin kiran salla daga Wikimedia Commons ne da lasisi na kyauta, muryoyin malamai da na Masallatai Masu Alfarma biyu kuma daga Internet Archive (archive.org) da islamweb.net; haƙƙinsu na masu su ne, kuma ana cire su idan sun nema. Daga kowanne an yanke kiran salla kawai aka sake sanya shi:
about.copyright: © {years} {name}. An tanadi duk haƙƙoƙin zane, lambar shirye-shirye da sunan manhajar.
about.rightsText: Nassoshin Alƙur'ani, azkar, littattafan hadisi da tafsirai, da kuma sautuka, mallakar masu haƙƙinsu ne da majiyoyin da aka ambata a sama, kuma ana nuna su kamar yadda suke. Manhajar kyauta ce; ba a yarda a kwafe ta, a sake wallafa ta da wani suna ko a sayar da ita ba tare da izini a rubuce ba.
